ashrafs-bh.cod_notes: No BNPL or cash-on-delivery stated on policy pages; footer payment logos show Visa, Mastercard, JCB and one local card logo only. www.ashrafs.com refused connections; the live store is www.ashrafsbahrain.com.
ashrafs-bh.delivery_days: Next business day, may slip 2-3 working days; large appliances / TVs 50in+ delivered by supplier in 5-7 business days
ashrafs-bh.returns_notes: Exchange or refund within 7 days. Excludes laptops, tablets, printers, mobile phones, cameras/camcorders, DVDs/CDs, personal care. Opened but unused items: 15% restocking fee. DOA/defective within 15 days exchanged/refunded after technical test. Original invoice required; returns at Hoora showroom; card refunds to card only.
ashrafs-bh.warranty_policy: Manufacturer's warranty (claims via manufacturer's authorised service centre); optional paid Ashrafs Extended Warranty starts after manufacturer warranty expires and includes a one-time replacement guarantee during manufacturer warranty.

bnpl.notes: Terms & conditions list BNPL 'such as Tabby, Tamara etc.'; instalment count not stated by Jumbo
Named in terms & conditions as a BNPL option; Tamara terms embedded in /terms-and-conditions; instalment count not stated
Easy Pay bank card instalments (0% interest, 3-24 months; Emirates NBD/Emirates Islamic; processing fee e.g. 9% for 18m, 12% for 24m)

jumbo-ae.cod_notes: Terms & conditions offer Cash on Delivery (COD) or Credit Card on Delivery (CCOD); no limit or fee stated.
jumbo-ae.delivery_days: 5-7 working days (7-10 outside delivery areas), no Friday/holiday delivery (per terms & conditions)
jumbo-ae.returns_notes: 7 days from delivery or in-store collection. Electronics must be unopened/unused with seals intact; 15% restocking fee on non-defective opened items; accessories, storage, software/games, headphones, personal care non-returnable. Online refunds to original payment method within 7 business days (older T&C page says credit vouchers only).
jumbo-ae.warranty_policy: Limited warranty from the brand/manufacturer/distributor; Jumbo acts as retailer only. Paid Jumbo extended warranty available.

bnpl.notes: Terms state bank-card offers do not apply to 'Tabby or Tamara's purchases' (implies accepted); instalment count not stated
Same terms clause; instalment count not stated

almanea-sa.cod_notes: Not stated on terms or services pages.
almanea-sa.delivery_days: 3-5 working days maximum in major cities (Sun-Thu delivery); extra fee outside Riyadh, Dammam, Jeddah, Al-Kharj
almanea-sa.returns_notes: 7 days from purchase, unopened/unused with all packaging; mobiles, computers, tablets, cameras only within 24 hours and unopened. Change-of-mind returns after delivery charged 2% of invoice (min SAR 100) plus return fees. Software/games and gift items non-returnable. Delivery fee is 'for a fee' with amounts behind a link not stated in text.
almanea-sa.warranty_policy: Manufacturer / authorised agent warranty of two years from purchase; claims go to the agent, not Almanea. Original invoice required.

bnpl.notes: Tabby logo in site payment methods; instalment count not stated
Tamara logo in site payment methods; instalment count not stated

saco-sa.cod_notes: Payment options shown (Mada, Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Apple Pay, STC Pay, Tabby, Tamara etc.) include no cash option; COD not stated either way.
saco-sa.returns_notes: Returns within 7 days of purchase, exchanges within 14 days; online orders returned to store within 14 days of delivery. Must be unused, original packaging, original invoice. Defective electrical items need an agent's report. Delivery + assembly SAR 150. Customer pays return shipping unless item defective/wrong.
saco-sa.warranty_policy: Saco maintenance/warranty policy: items with an authorised agent go to the agent's service centre; device warranty stated as 2 years (battery 6 months, charger 1 month); original Saco invoice required. Paid 'Dhaman Plus' extended warranty available.

bnpl.notes: 4 monthly instalments, no fees, first at order; site config shows max SAR 4,000
3 instalments, first at order, rest within two months

alsaif-sa.cod_notes: Saudi Arabia only; COD fee SAR 28, non-refundable on returns; orders outside Riyadh must be confirmed via WhatsApp before shipping.
alsaif-sa.returns_notes: Return period 3 days, exchange 7 days; discounted items exchange only; used items not returnable; Tabby/Tamara purchases replaced via voucher within 7 days. Terms note free shipping does not apply to ACs (SAR 160 shipping + installation); no general delivery fee/threshold stated (given after purchase).
alsaif-sa.warranty_policy: Al Saif Gallery gives a 3-year warranty on its own Edison brand; other brands carry only the authorised dealer's warranty.

bnpl.notes: Own 'Easy Credit' instalments via an Alghanim company, and XPay lease (up to KD 500, default 4-month term). Tabby/Tamara/Deema not stated on any policy page.

xcite-kw.cod_notes: Policy pages list KNET, Visa, Mastercard, Apple Pay only; COD not stated.
xcite-kw.returns_notes: Return/exchange within 14 days of delivery, original saleable condition (FAQ: sealed). No refunds on e-delivery products. Delivery: free 'All-Day Delivery' on most products; specific time slots may cost extra; 3-Hour Express KD 1.500, 1-Hour Super Express KD 2.000. Click & collect conflicting: T&C 9.12 references Click & Collect orders but FAQ says no showroom pickups.
xcite-kw.warranty_policy: Minimum 1-year manufacturing warranty on all products (5 years on cooling compressors); paid Xcare extended warranty up to 5 years.

jumbosouq-qa.cod_notes: Cash or card payment on delivery accepted; no limit/fee stated. No BNPL stated (Visa/MC, Amex, Apple Pay, Doha Bank internet banking).
jumbosouq-qa.returns_notes: Return within 14 days of receipt, undamaged with all accessories; but page also says no return/exchange after 3 days of delivery (conflict). Earphones, mobiles, laptops, TVs, large appliances etc. not returnable unless manufacturer defect; QAR 200 deduction on certain appliances. Delivery free within Qatar unless otherwise mentioned.
jumbosouq-qa.warranty_policy: Manufacturer's warranty only, valid in Qatar; repairs/replacements handled by the manufacturer, not JS.QA.

ansar-qa.cod_notes: Card on delivery and cash on delivery accepted (payment policy); FAQ says COD for supermarket orders up to QAR 500. Minimum order QAR 20. No BNPL stated.
ansar-qa.delivery_days: Choice of three time slots at checkout; next-day slot for orders after 10 PM
ansar-qa.returns_notes: General 7-day return policy (T&C apply). Faulty items refunded within 3 days; laptops, tablets, phones, cameras, storage, consoles/games etc. only returnable if defective within 3 days. Express orders 9 AM-10 PM delivered within one hour.
ansar-qa.warranty_policy: All products carry warranty as shown on the delivered invoice; keep invoice as proof. Provider/duration not stated.
